spans.s:
√has (hásati, -te; jahā́sa, jahasé; hasiṣyáti;
hasitá; hásitum; hasitvā́; -hásya).
laugh.
+ pra, laugh out, laugh.
+ vi, laugh out.
hasta-gṛ́hya, grd. taking by the hand.

hastín, a. having hands; w. mṛgá, the
beast with the hand, i. e. trunk, Vedic
designation of the elephant; as m. elephant;
 Hastin, name of an ancient king.
[hasta, q. v.]

hastināpura, n. Hastināpura, a town
on the Ganges, home of the Kurus, said
to have been founded by king Hastin.
[cf. pura.]

hasti-rāja, m. elephant-king, leader of
a herd of elephants.
hasti-snāna, n. ablution of an elephant.

hāsya, grdv. to be laughed at; as n.
laughter; ridicule. [√has, 963^3c.]
